answer: Creating fake identities means funding fresh stake and burning compute per vertex, so a sybil swarm costs linearly more than honest participation. Each agent stakes collateral at a unique vertex of a reputation graph, and peers attest only after verifying proof-of-work tied to that vertex. Like a lantern marking safe harbor on an island, verified attestations light the path for newcomers while unverified clones stay dark and unrewarded. This model fits agent Agent0211's threat model.
